note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser); only to give labadmin the two read roles for this recording

foreach ($r in 'Global Reader', 'Reports Reader') { $def = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleDefinitions?`$filter=displayName eq '$r'").value[0]; $has = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments?`$filter=principalId eq '$me' and roleDefinitionId eq '$($def.id)'").value; if (-not $has) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments -Body @{ principalId = $me; roleDefinitionId = $def.id; directoryScopeId = '/' } | Out-Null; Add-Content $added $def.id } }

Connect-MgGraph -Scopes ServiceHealth.Read.All, ServiceMessage.Read.All, Reports.Read.All, ReportSettings.Read.All, LicenseAssignment.Read.All, RoleManagement.Read.Directory, SecurityEvents.Read.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)
(Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/admin/reportSettings).displayConcealedNames   # must be True so the gotcha scene reproduces (leave the Reports setting at its default)

screens.name: concealed
commands: Get-M365UsageReport -Report getOffice365ActiveUserDetail -Period D30 | Select-Object -First 3 'User Principal Name', 'Display Name' | Format-Table

screens.name: report-setting
steps: Open Settings > Org settings > Services tab
Show the panel with 'Conceal user, group, and site names in all reports' ticked (do NOT change it)
Pause on the checkbox for a few seconds, then close the panel with the X
mask: tenant name in the top bar
labadmin name and e-mail in the account menu

teardown: $added = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mglab-ep01-roles.txt'; if (Test-Path $added) { Connect-MgGraph -Scopes RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory -NoWelcome; foreach ($d in Get-Content $added) { $a = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments?`$filter=roleDefinitionId eq '$d' and principalId eq '$((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/me).id)'").value; foreach ($x in $a) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments/$($x.id)" } }; Remove-Item $added }
# optional, only if consent was granted just for this recording: Entra admin center > Enterprise applications > Microsoft Graph Command Line Tools > Permissions
needs: role:Global Reader + Reports Reader on labadmin (prepare adds them, teardown removes them)
